meta.title: FlyWire v630 · sugar-stimulus model replay
meta.extractionMethod: Existing activity-replay.html embedded dataset; generated by sesame_flybrain/build_replay.py.
meta.recordedAtBasis: Original published model run date is not present in the local export; source fileModifiedAt is the local artifact timestamp only.
meta.layout: Spectral graph layout, compressed with tanh; not anatomical coordinates.
meta.edgeSelection: 650 strongest nonzero connections among neurons active in trial 0; signs retained, original magnitudes not included in replay export.

units.nodes.count: number of recorded model spikes in this trial
units.edges: [source node index, destination node index, sign (+1 excitatory / -1 inhibitory)]

limitations: Spikes are outputs of the published computational model, not recordings from a living animal.
Only neurons that fired in the selected trial are shown; this is not the full brain graph.
Node positions represent graph structure and do not show biological neuron locations.
This replay does not run a neural model or send commands to hardware.
The neural replay and the walking telemetry are independent recordings with no shared clock or demonstrated causal link.
